title: Dark Portals
description: PortalDark is a lightweight Spigot plugin that enhances portal mechanics by introducing mob spawning behavior tied to Nether Portals. Instead of portals being just a doorway, they now act as a source of danger, spawning hostile mobs nearby when active.
body:
🔥 PortalDark

PortalDark transforms Nether Portals into dangerous structures by making them spawn hostile mobs nearby. No longer just a doorway to the Nether – now portals themselves are a threat!

⚙️ Features

Mobs spawn around Nether Portals at regular intervals.

Works even in well-lit areas – torches won’t protect you!

Configurable per-world support.

Fully customizable mob list and spawn settings.

Adds a new layer of danger and excitement to survival.

👾 Default Mobs

🧟 Zombie

☠️ Skeleton

💥 Creeper

👾 Enderman

📂 Configuration (config.yml)
enabled-worlds:
  - world
  - Void
spawn-radius: 3
spawn-rate: 200
mobs:
  - ZOMBIE
  - SKELETON
  - CREEPER
  - ENDERMAN

⌨️ Commands

/portaldark reload → Reloads the config without restarting the server

🛡️ Permissions

portaldark.reload → Allows reloading

🎯 Why Use PortalDark?

Make portals dangerous and immersive.

Add extra challenge to survival or hardcore servers.

Perfect for adventure maps where portals act like enemy spawners.

Would you like me to also make a short tagline (one-liner under the title) for Modrinth like:
👉 “Turns Nether Portals into mob-spawning hazards to increase survival difficulty.”
